b2-magyaridentitas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Is Hungarian So Different?
b2-magyaridentitas-01.scenario: At a language café in Budapest, a visitor asks you, a learner of Hungarian, why Hungarian is so different from the languages around it.
b2-magyaridentitas-01.prompt: Tell the visitor where Hungarian comes from and what it borrowed.
cues: Say what family Hungarian belongs to
Say that it is surrounded by other kinds of languages, with a concession
Say what the core vocabulary is, and add a contrast
b2-magyaridentitas-01.target: A magyar finnugor eredetű, agglutináló nyelv, jóllehet szláv, germán és újlatin nyelvek veszik körül. A szókincsében török és szláv jövevényszavak is vannak; mindazonáltal az alapszókincse finnugor eredetű.
b2-magyaridentitas-01.english: Hungarian is a Finno-Ugric, agglutinative language, although Slavic, Germanic and Romance languages surround it. Its vocabulary also has Turkic and Slavic loanwords; nevertheless its core vocabulary is of Finno-Ugric origin.
b2-magyaridentitas-01.canDo: I can explain the Finno-Ugric genealogical origin of Hungarian and its position as an agglutinative island language.

b2-magyaridentitas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Do Hungarians Respect Poets?
b2-magyaridentitas-02.scenario: In a literature class in Budapest, a classmate asks you why poets are so important in Hungarian culture.
b2-magyaridentitas-02.prompt: Tell your classmate how the tradition sees poets.
cues: Say what the traditional view is
Name one poet and one fact from the reading
b2-magyaridentitas-02.target: A hagyományos felfogás szerint a költő a nemzet lelkiismerete. Radnóti Miklós a halálmenet sarában menetelve is verseket írt füzetbe.
b2-magyaridentitas-02.english: According to the traditional view, the poet is the conscience of the nation. Radnóti Miklós wrote poems in a notebook even while marching in the mud of the death march.
b2-magyaridentitas-02.canDo: I can explain why Hungarian tradition sees poets from Petőfi to Radnóti as the conscience of the nation.

b2-magyaridentitas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Humour
b2-magyaridentitas-03.scenario: At a café in Budapest, a foreign guest asks you, a learner, what Hungarian humour is like and why people say Hungarians laugh through tears.
b2-magyaridentitas-03.prompt: Tell the guest what the reading says about melancholy and humour.
cues: Mention both melancholy and gallows humour with egyfelől ... másfelől
Say what Hungarian humour is not, with nem annyira ..., mint inkább
b2-magyaridentitas-03.target: Egyfelől jelen van a történelmi melankólia, másfelől az akasztófahumor segít a nehéz helyzetekben. A magyar humor nem annyira felelőtlenség, mint inkább a túlélés stratégiája.
b2-magyaridentitas-03.english: On the one hand historical melancholy is present, on the other hand gallows humour helps in hard situations. Hungarian humour is not so much irresponsibility as a survival strategy.
b2-magyaridentitas-03.canDo: I can describe how Hungarian culture is said to combine melancholy and self-ironic humour.

b2-magyaridentitas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Between the Lines
b2-magyaridentitas-04.scenario: At a table with Hungarian friends in a Budapest pub, a new learner asks you why everybody laughed at a short remark. You explain that it was a literary allusion.
b2-magyaridentitas-04.prompt: Tell the new learner what is hidden in such remarks.
cues: Say what kinds of allusions fill conversations
Say why knowing sayings is useful, with egyszersmind
b2-magyaridentitas-04.target: A magyar beszélgetésekben sok az irodalmi és történelmi utalás. A szállóigék ismerete szórakoztató, egyszersmind a finom árnyalatok megértésének kulcsa; mindamellett ehhez a sorok között is olvasni kell.
b2-magyaridentitas-04.english: Hungarian conversations contain many literary and historical allusions. Knowing sayings is entertaining and at the same time a key to subtle nuances; nevertheless, for this you also have to read between the lines.
b2-magyaridentitas-04.canDo: I can recognise cultural allusions and well-known sayings in Hungarian conversation.

b2-magyaridentitas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After B2
b2-magyaridentitas-05.scenario: At the end of your B2 course in Budapest, your teacher asks how you feel and what you want to do next.
b2-magyaridentitas-05.prompt: Tell your teacher how you feel and what comes next.
cues: Say how you feel about your knowledge
Say what you look forward to
Say what the text says begins after B2
b2-magyaridentitas-05.target: Büszke vagyok a megszerzett tudásra, és izgatottan várom a magyar irodalom további felfedezését. A B2 bizonyítvány után kezdődik az igazi felfedezés.
b2-magyaridentitas-05.english: I am proud of the knowledge I have gained and look forward to discovering more Hungarian literature. The real discovery begins after the B2 certificate.
b2-magyaridentitas-05.canDo: I can reflect on my linguistic and cultural journey to B2 mastery in Hungarian and chart a course toward C1 fluency.

b2-magyaridentitas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Learned About Hungarian
b2-magyaridentitas-consolidation.scenario: At a farewell dinner in Budapest, a Hungarian friend asks you to sum up what you learned about the language and culture.
b2-magyaridentitas-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what you learned about Hungarian identity.
cues: Say what kind of language Hungarian is, with a concession
Say what the tradition thinks of poets
b2-magyaridentitas-consolidation.target: A magyar szigetnyelv, jóllehet sok idegen hatás érte. A költők hagyományosan a nemzet lelkiismeretét képviselték, a magyar humor pedig a túlélés stratégiája.
b2-magyaridentitas-consolidation.english: Hungarian is an island language, although many foreign influences reached it. Poets traditionally represented the conscience of the nation, and Hungarian humour is a survival strategy.
b2-magyaridentitas-consolidation.canDo: I can synthesize the overarching themes of Hungarian cultural, literary, and historical identity at B2 mastery.
